What makes addiction so hard to escape—and why do some people become vulnerable long before they ever take a substance?
In this episode of The Pulse of Addiction , Alex Doyle sits down with Dr. Judy Grisel , a behavioral neuroscientist, Professor of Psychology and Neuroscience at Bucknell University, and author of the New York Times bestselling book Never Enough: The Neuroscience and Experience of Addiction . Dr. Grisel brings together decades of scientific research and lived experience to talk honestly about addiction, recovery, the brain, vulnerability, and what people often misunderstand about substance use.bucknell+1
Judy’s journey is not only academic. After experiencing addiction herself as a young person and finding recovery in her twenties, she went on to earn a doctorate in behavioral neuroscience and build a career studying the biological roots of addiction.
